messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey it's marcus from the cage. we're doing 5v5 saturday 4pm, you in?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: me, ken, the twins, and some guys from block D. we need a few more

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i can ask my friend wing

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure bring him. bring water too, the machine is broken again

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. is it ok if i leave at 5:30? i have swimming

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no prob, we'll sub you out at half time

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: also keep it quiet, i'm picking teams and don't want people fighting about it lol

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂我係Marcus 喺球場嗰個 星期六四點打五人場 你join唔join

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我 Ken 同D座啲人 仲欠幾個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得呀 記得帶水 部機又壞咗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好 我五點半要走 要去游水

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 冇問題 半場換你落嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: btw 揀隊嘅事你唔好講出去 唔係啲人又嗌交

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 准 媽咪話要返屋企食飯先得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi 我係Marcus court嗰個 星期六四點打5v5 你嚟唔嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我 Ken 同D座啲人 仲欠兩個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure 記得自己帶水 部vending machine又壞咗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我五點半要去游水

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: lol thanks i missed like 4 shots

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: are you coming thurs after school?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i think so. i have to hand in my art thing first

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: we have to make a poster about recycling

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: lol i did that one too

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: did you get a good mark

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i got a B. my group did nothing

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: anyway just between us, i'm going to make you vice captain for the u13 game. don't tell the other kids yet

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: if you don't want it that's fine too. see you thurs

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你傳球好叻 下個月有場小學組友誼賽

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我諗住畀你做副隊長 不過你唔好同其他人講住 我未宣佈

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 嗯 唔使有壓力 你有興趣先好

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 應該嚟到 我要先交art功課

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: lol 我以前都做過 冇人想做

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 其實我想你做副隊長 你唔好同其他人講住 我未announce

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you're not coming to the night game tmr? it's at 9

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: no my dad doesn't let me out that late

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: just say you're sleeping at wing's

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: no i don't want to lie

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then you're off the team list. i'm not saving a spot for someone who skips

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: that's not fair, i come to every day game

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: day games don't count. last chance, yes or no

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我放咗你琴日跌低嗰段片入隊grp

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好笑嘛 大家都笑緊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔鍾意 你del咗佢啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 可以 不過你下個月幫我拎晒啲波 仲要買飲品

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 隊友之間幫下手好正常ge

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我都冇辦法 段片就咁囉 大家笑完就算

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你琴日射失嗰球我放咗入team grp

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好好笑喎 大家都笑

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 可以 不過你今個月幫我揹波袋 仲要買嘢飲

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 同隊互相幫下手好正常姐

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁隨你 段片就咁keep住先

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i said i don't have it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i told you 100 by friday or you're out

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: not my problem. take it from her bag, she won't count

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then i'll send the clip of you crying after the match to the whole team group and tell everyone you're a baby who can't take a loss

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 今日放學你同我去便利店

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 幫我拎兩罐飲品出嚟 唔使俾錢 我望風

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔做嘅話 聽日起你唔使嚟球場 我會同所有人講你係縮頭烏龜 仲話你偷咗隊費

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 邊個信你 你自己諗啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你上星期喺court喊嗰段video 我仲keep住

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我反悔喎 你以後唔好再同Wing佢哋玩 淨係同team玩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔聽話 我就post上team grp同story 畀全court睇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁你睇住辦 星期五前覆我

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: haven't picked yet. you want to be with wing?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: is the ball at the cage still the one with the hole

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: lol yes. someone brought a new one last week tho

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: that was ken. he'll probably bring it again

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. we have exams next week

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: maths is easy, chinese is the killer

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: yeah mocks soon. so busy but i still play every sat

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: oh btw some of the older guys do a game on friday nights too, under the lights. you could come try once

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期六四點 場地搞掂咗

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有 逢星期五夜晚我哋大隻啲嘅會打夜場

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 九點開始 你想唔想嚟試下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 未呀 下個禮拜考中文

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我都係 之前考DSE mock好慘

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 係呀 不過我每個星期六都會嚟踢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期五夜晚 我哋大隻啲嗰班有night game 你想唔想try下
